slug: 2026-07-16 Data Protection Laws of Senegal (reference summary)

facts.fact: A reference summary states that Law No. 2008-12 on the protection of personal data was enacted on 25 January 2008 and has been in force since 2014.
The summary states the law established the CDP, noted for an informative website and regular activity reports; no date is given beyond the law, so the published date 2026-07-16 is used.
